programme.sub-title: The young males of the lion pride must form a coalition to work together against their rivals, but they first need to leave their mothers at two years old and fend for themselves

programme.sub-title: The life story of a charismatic hippo in Zambia's Luangwa Valley. Over 35 years, he grows from a small calf to a full-fledged leader. His experiences make him stronger and stronger, until he is ready for kingship

programme.sub-title: Gary searches for a gator in a disgusting drainage ditch while Arlie finds one hanging out in a crystal clear pool. Then, the Gator Country team hits the road for a show in Fort Worth

programme.title: த சவன்னா: வைல்ட் ஹேப்பினஸ்
programme.desc: The Savannah: Wild Happiness.

programme.title: ரிவர் மான்ஸ்டர்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: Jeremy Wade investigates a case in Nepal that sounds strangely familiar - a lone fisherman dragged off his feet and into a mountain river by the original river monster, the goonch catfish
programme.desc: நாட்டுப்புற கதைகள், புதிர்களை தகர்த்து நன்னீர் கண்டுபிடிப்பு இரகசியங்களை பற்றி உயிரியலாளர் ஜெர்மி வெட்ட வெளியிடுகிறார்.

programme.title: நேச்சர்'ஸ் ஃபாஸ்ட் அட்டாக்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: Showcasing how the world's fastest predators can strike and kill in the blink of an eye, using modern high-speed cameras to capture these lightning-fast attacks in deadly detail
programme.desc: இயற்கையின் மிகப் பெரிய கொடிய மிருகங்களை ஆவணப்படுத்தும் இயக்குனர், அவற்றின் இரையைத் தாக்கும் முறைகளை விளக்குகிறார்.

programme.sub-title: An engrossing journey into the lives of Asian Elephants, and the stunning bio-diverse North Eastern jungles of India around the river Brahmaputra
programme.desc: வடகிழக்கு இந்திய காடுகளில் ஆசிய யானைகளையும், மனிதருக்கும் விலங்குகளுக்கும் இணக்கமான எதிர்காலத்திற்கான முயற்சிகளும்.

programme.title: லோவென் கெகன் ஹ்யானென்
programme.sub-title: A year has passed since the lionesses of the Boulder Pride bore their cubs. The youngsters have got much bigger and, amazingly, all nine have survived. But the lions in the northern savannah on the border of Kenya and Tanzania have a problem

programme.desc: உயிரியலாளரும் இயற்கை ஆர்வலருமான டான் ஓ நீல், ஆராய்ச்சி மையத்தை உருவாக்கி பனிச்சிறுத்தையை பற்றி ஆய்வு செய்ய முயலுகிறார்.

programme.desc: Adventurer Sean Duggan heads to some of the most remote places on Earth in search of mysterious creatures - from land-prowling fish to giant predatory reptiles - in `Natural Born Monsters'. Duggan often enlists the help of local experts to locate and investigate the creatures and get the information he seeks.

programme.desc: ஆஸ்டின் ஸ்டீவன்ஸ், உலகின் மிகப்பெரிய விஷப் பாம்பான ராஜ நாகத்தைத் தேடி தென்னிந்தியாவின் தொலைதூரக் காடுகளுக்கு செல்கிறார்.

programme.title: ப்ரதர்ஹூட் ஆஃப் லயன்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: The young males of the lion pride must form a coalition to work together against their rivals, but they first need to leave their mothers at two years old and fend for themselves
programme.desc: கென்யா மசாய் மாரா காட்டில் சிங்கங்களின் வாழ்க்கை, அவை எதிர்கொள்ளும் வேட்டையாடுதல் மற்றும் வாழ்விட இழப்பு பற்றி அறிக.

programme.title: Nuts About Squirrels
programme.desc: Some people love squirrels, others see them as pests and glorified rats, but we can all agree that the characterful rodents are speedy, quirky, exceptional climbers and go crazy for nuts.

programme.title: Super snakes
programme.desc: Snakes are a feature of nearly every culture in the world. 100,000 people die every year because of them. But we also owe our survival to snake predation on rodents. They attract a mythology which sometimes leaves the truth eating dust.

programme.title: லைஃப் ஆஃப் அ ப்ரெடேட்டர்
programme.desc: Track three apex predators, a golden eagle, an Iberian lynx and a red fox, as they navigate changing seasons and deploy unique hunting strategies to survive within their shared Mediterranean forest territory.

programme.title: ரேஸ் ஆஃப் லைஃப்
programme.sub-title: There are many fine examples of evolutionary history in the natural world. Animals adapt through a series of small, random mutations and usually do so in order to compete more effectively for food, water and space. Crocodiles are certainly of an ancient lineage, they are believed to be 200 million years old. Sharks have gone through the process of adaptation and evolutionary experimentation as well
programme.desc: சூழலில் தழுவி, விலங்குகளிடமிருந்து தங்களை பாதுகாக்க காலப்போக்கில் உருவாகிய பல்வேறு உயிரினங்களை பற்றி கூறும் தொகுப்பாளர்.

programme.sub-title: We follow the unforgettable journey of a family of wild dogs in Zimbabwe and witness rarely seen behaviour, from tender moments with newborn pups, to the thrills of hunting wildebeest, to close encounters with their greatest enemy - the lion
programme.desc: ஜிம்பாப்வேயில் நெருக்கமாக பிணைக்கப்பட்ட காட்டு நாய்களின் அசாதாரண பயணத்தையும் அவற்றின் வேட்டையாடும் தருணங்களையும் அறிக.

programme.title: பிக் கேட்ஸ் ஸ்மால் வர்ல்ட்
programme.sub-title: Welcome spring on the Gomoti River, where cheetah mum Phefo and lion mum Tshaba are teaching their cubs survival skills whilst keeping them out of the jaws of big male cats
programme.desc: போட்ஸ்வானாவின் கோமோட்டி நதியில் தங்கி தங்கள் திறமைகளால் போட்டியாளர்களை தடுக்கும் மூன்று பெரிய பூனை குடும்பங்கள்.

programme.title: Fear on the Savannah
programme.desc: Authorities introduced lions in a rehabilitated national park where only herbivores lived, and fear overtook the park.

programme.title: அ கேம் ஆஃப் லெப்பர்ட் த்ரோன்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: Filmed over ten years, an in-depth look at the leopard characters of South Africa and their fascinating unfolding story once their Queen dies
programme.desc: சாபி சாண்ட்ஸ் கேம் ரிசர்வில் தங்களுடைய 12 ஆண்டுகால ராணி மறைந்த பிறகு, மேலாதிக்கத்திற்காக சண்டையிடும் சிறுத்தைகள்.

programme.title: த டோவர்ஸ் வர்ல்ட்
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker provides comprehensive insights into the alluring biodiversity of the Himalayas, while focusing on the vivid wildlife
programme.desc: இமயமலையின் வசீகரிக்கும் பல்லுயிர்த்தன்மை பற்றிய நுண்ணறிவுகளை வழங்கி, தெளிவான வனவிலங்குகளை குறித்து விளக்கும் இயக்குனர்.

programme.title: பிக் கேட் டேல்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: Chongo is unwilling to share buffalo with the rest of the pride and Fig continues to give vital lessons to the young cub and a cheetah and hyena battle
programme.desc: வேட்டையாட, துணையை தேட, இடங்களை காப்பாற்ற, குட்டிகளை வளர்க்க போராடும் பெரிய பூனைகளின் வெவ்வேறு இனங்களின் ஆவணம்.

programme.title: சர்வைவிங் ஆஸ்திரேலியா
programme.sub-title: Aussies who've survived the fury of nature and encountered deadly threats in their own backyard share their stories as the country's suburban residents increasingly find themselves in the vicinity of dangerous wildlife
programme.desc: ஆஸ்திரேலிய வனப்பகுதியிலிருந்து தப்பிப் பிழைத்தவர்களின் அனுபவங்களையும், அங்கு உயிர் பிழைக்கத் தேவையான நடைமுறை உத்திகளையும் இந்த ஆவணப்படம் விவரிக்கிறது.

programme.title: டெட்லியஸ்ட் சௌத் ஆஃப்ரிக்கா
programme.sub-title: Kurt Greenwood is on a quest to seek out South Africa's 12 most deadly snakes and to educate and inspire people to see the value of these often misunderstood creatures
programme.desc: தென்னாப்பிரிக்காவின் கொடிய பன்னிரண்டு பாம்புகளை தேடி, தவறாக அறியப்படும் அவற்றின் மதிப்பை கற்பிக்கும் குர்ட் கிரீன்வுட்.

programme.title: ப்ரதர்ஹூட் ஆஃப் லயன்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: Five male lion cubs compete with each other while hunting their prey, but their family ties become increasingly complicated as they make their gradual rise to reign in the territory
programme.desc: கென்யா மசாய் மாரா காட்டில் சிங்கங்களின் வாழ்க்கை, அவை எதிர்கொள்ளும் வேட்டையாடுதல் மற்றும் வாழ்விட இழப்பு பற்றி அறிக.

programme.title: அமுர், ஏஷியா'ஸ் அமேசான்
programme.sub-title: The Amur or Heilongjiang, as it is called in China, is one of the planet's ten mightiest rivers, yet it is hardly known to westerners

programme.title: க்லேடியேட்டர்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: There are clashes over precious resources when the dry season brings a band of gladiators to an African savannah watering hole. There is a lion-elephant territory brawl, an ant raid on a termite mound and a honey badger's dance with a deadly snake
programme.desc: நான்கு தனித்துவமான சுற்றுச்சூழல்களில் வாழ சிறிய எறும்புகள் முதல் பெரிய கரடிகள் வரை விலங்குகள் வாழ போராடுவது பற்றி அறிக.

programme.title: శివ
programme.sub-title: Shiva is a brave and intelligent child who stays with his grandparents in Vedas City. He sets out with his gang of friends to save the citizens from all sorts of evil
programme.desc: వేదాస్ నగరంలో తన బామ్మాతాతాలతో నివసించే ధైర్యంగల శివ, మిత్రులతో కలిసి తన నగరాన్ని దుష్ట శక్తుల నుండి కాపాడాలనుకుంటాడు.

credits.actor: Nilufer Middey,Sonal Kaushal,Rupa Bhimani,Anamay Verma,Aditya Jaiswal,Brij Bhushan Sawhney,Manoj Pandey

programme.title: పాక్ పకావు
programme.sub-title: Follow the whimsical and absurd conversations of two friends and learn new things as they navigate life's everyday mysteries
programme.desc: ఇద్దరు స్నేహితుల విచిత్రమైన, మరియు అసంబద్ధమైన సంభాషణలను అనుసరించండి మరియు వారు జీవితంలోని కొత్త విషయాలను నేర్చుకోండి.

programme.title: పకడమ్ పకడై - ధమాకేదార్ ఇన్‌వెన్షన్స్
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in cinema
programme.desc: సినిమా రంగంలోని అత్యుత్తమమైన సినిమాలను కొన్నింటిని అందిస్తారు.

programme.title: ది ఆడ్వెంచర్స్ ఆఫ్ బెర్నీ
programme.sub-title: Bernie, a hermit crab, fails to help Zig eat Marina and gets lost at the bottom of the ocean. Meanwhile, he plans on returning to the island
programme.desc: మెరీనాని తినడానికి జిగ్ కి సాయం చేయడంలో విఫలమై సముద్రం అడుగున తప్పిపోయిన బెర్నీ అనేపీత ద్వీపానికి తిరిగి రావాలనుకుంటాడు.

programme.title: పినాకి అండ్ హ్యాపీ
programme.sub-title: The ghost family faces a direct head-to-head collision with humans as the supernatural world is turned upside down. Pinaki and Happy must navigate a wave of chaotic spirit pranks to restore balance and keep their household secrets perfectly safe
programme.desc: Happy and Pinaki live with their ghost family in Vibhooti Mansion. They embark on spooky adventures, uncover scary secrets, and discover courage, friendship, and bravery together.

programme.title: ది భూత్ బంధుస్: ఖాలీ దిమాగ్ షైతాన్ కా ఘర్
programme.sub-title: A ghost named Bhootkaal seizes control and infiltrates Happy's mind, causing complete mayhem. To save his best friend, Pinaki must overcome the spirit in three tasks in under 30 minutes
programme.desc: భూత్‌కాల్ అనే దెయ్యం హ్యాపీని ఆవహించగా, తన మిత్రుడిని కాపాడుకోవడానికి పినాకి 30 నిమిషాల్లో మూడు సవాళ్లలో ఆ దెయ్యాన్ని ఓడించాల్సి ఉంటుంది.

programme.title: డోరేమాన్ ది మూవీ: నోబితా అండ్ ది బర్త్ ఆఫ్ జపాన్
programme.sub-title: Doraemon and his friends travel to ancient Japan where they meet Kukuru. When Kukuru tells them that his tribe has been enslaved by Gigazombie, Doraemon decides to help him
programme.desc: ప్రాచీన జపాన్‌కు ప్రయాణించిన డోరేమాన్, అతని స్నేహితులకు, గిగాజోంబీ తన తెగను బానిసలుగా మార్చాడని కుకురు చెప్పినప్పుడు వారికి సహాయం చేయాలనుకుంటారు.

programme.title: జిగ్ అండ్ షార్కో
programme.sub-title: Zig the hyena lives all alone on a desert island and schemes to eat Marina
programme.desc: జిగ్ అనే హైనా, మెరీనా అనే మత్స్యకన్యను తినడానికి ప్రయత్నిస్తుంది, కానీ ఆమె మిత్రుడు షార్కో ఆమెని జిగ్ నుండి కాపాడతాడు.

credits.director: Olivier Jean-Marie,Andrés Fernández,Cédric Dietsch,Khalil Ben Naamane,Yani Ouabdesselam,Nicolas Bougard,Pierre-Gilles Stehr

programme.title: భూత్ బంధుస్ అండ్ ద పవర్ ఆఫ్ త్రీ
programme.sub-title: A ghost family raises an abandoned baby boy, Pinaki, at the Vibhooti Mansion in the Modern City. Things take a humorous turn when he attends public school and gets exposed to the real world
programme.desc: విభూతి భవనంలో దెయ్యాల కుటుంబంలో పెరిగిన పినాకి, ప్రభుత్వ పాఠశాలలో చేరినప్పుడు వాస్తవ ప్రపంచాన్ని ఎదుర్కొంటాడు.

programme.title: పినాకి అండ్ హ్యాపీ -ది భూత్ బంధుస్
programme.sub-title: Pinaki and his family of ghosts embark on spooky adventures and a series of fun and slapstick comedy as they try to fit in the outside world
programme.desc: పినాకి, అతని దెయ్యాల కుటుంబం బయటి ప్రపంచంలో ఇమిడిపోవడానికి ప్రయత్నిస్తూ, భయానక సాహసాలు, హాస్య సంఘటనల పరంపరలో పయనిస్తారు.

programme.sub-title: Shiva is a brave and intelligent child who stays with his grandparents in Vedas City. He sets out with his gang of friends to save the citizens from all sorts of evil
programme.desc: వేదాస్ నగరంలో తన బామ్మాతాతాలతో నివసించే ధైర్యంగల శివ, మిత్రులతో కలిసి తన నగరాన్ని దుష్ట శక్తుల నుండి కాపాడాలనుకుంటాడు.

programme.title: పక్డమ్ పక్డై
programme.sub-title: There is a constant war between Doggy Don and the three clever mice who live in his house. However, with the help of Doggy Don's brother, an ex-army dog, they fight the mice to win back their house
programme.desc: తన ఇంట్లో మూడు ఎలుకలతో నిరంతరం యుద్ధం చేసే డాగీ డాన్, మాజీ ఆర్మీ కుక్కతో కలిసి తమ ఇంటిని సొంతం చేసుకోడానికి పోరాడతాడు.

programme.title: పాక్ పకావు
programme.sub-title: Follow the whimsical and absurd conversations of two friends and learn new things as they navigate life's everyday mysteries
programme.desc: ఇద్దరు స్నేహితుల విచిత్రమైన, మరియు అసంబద్ధమైన సంభాషణలను అనుసరించండి మరియు వారు జీవితంలోని కొత్త విషయాలను నేర్చుకోండి.

programme.title: పకడమ్ పకడై - ధమాకేదార్ ఇన్‌వెన్షన్స్
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in cinema
programme.desc: సినిమా రంగంలోని అత్యుత్తమమైన సినిమాలను కొన్నింటిని అందిస్తారు.

programme.title: Zig Aur Marina Bff
programme.desc: Zig, a hyena, tries to attack Marina, a mermaid, but her friend Sharko stops him. Set in France, the trio's adventures unfold with humor everyday.

programme.title: పినాకి అండ్ హ్యాపీ
programme.sub-title: The ghost family faces a direct head-to-head collision with humans as the supernatural world is turned upside down. Pinaki and Happy must navigate a wave of chaotic spirit pranks to restore balance and keep their household secrets perfectly safe
programme.desc: Happy and Pinaki live with their ghost family in Vibhooti Mansion. They embark on spooky adventures, uncover scary secrets, and discover courage, friendship, and bravery together.

programme.title: పినాకి అండ్ హ్యాపీ ఇన్ ది డార్క్ అవర్
programme.sub-title: Happy and Pinaki live with a ghost family in Vibhooti Mansion, and they face eerie adventures while uncovering hidden frightening secrets about their home and themselves
programme.desc: డార్క్ అవర్ సమయంలో,పినాకి,హ్యాపీ కాలంతో పోటీ పడుతూ, చందూల కిరీటాన్ని దొంగిలించి భూత ప్రపంచాన్ని ఆపడానికి ప్రయత్నిస్తారు.

programme.title: డోరేమాన్: నోబితా అండ్ గెలాక్సీ సూపర్-ఎక్స్‌ప్రెస్
programme.sub-title: Nobita and his friends along with Doraemon go on a mystery trip through the cosmos on the Galaxy Super-express train. But trouble awaits them as soon as they reach the destination
programme.desc: గెలాక్సీ సూపర్-ఎక్స్‌ప్రెస్ రైలులో రహస్య యాత్రకు వెళ్లిన నోబితా, అతని మిత్రులు గమ్యం చేరుకునేలోపు అనేక కష్టాలు ఎదుర్కొంటారు.

credits.actor: Nobuyo Oyama (Doraemon),Noriko Ohara (Nobita Nobi),Michiko Nomura (Shizuka Minamoto),Kaneta Kiomtsuki (Suneo Honekawa),Kazuya Tatekabe (Takesi Goda),Mitsuaki Madono (Aston)

programme.desc: टेलीविज़न के एक से बढ़कर एक कार्यक्रमों को प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।.

programme.title: कोरेलेशन: यूजेज़ ऑफ एसेस्मेंट
programme.sub-title: With the help of examples, a subject-matter expert provides a comprehensive lecture on the uses of correlation in assessment
programme.desc: उदाहरणों की सहायता से, एक विषय विशेषज्ञ मूल्यांकन में सहसंबंध के उपयोग पर व्यापक व्याख्यान प्रस्तुत करते हैं।.

programme.title: एनाटॉमिक बेसिक ऑफ इकोकार्डियोग्राफी इन कॉन्जेनिटल हार्ट डिजिज़
programme.sub-title: A subject-matter expert delivers a detailed lecture on the anatomical basics of echocardiography in congenital heart disease
programme.desc: एक विषय विशेषज्ञ जन्मजात हृदय रोग में इकोकार्डियोग्राफी की शारीरिक मूल बातें पर विस्तृत व्याख्यान प्रस्तुत करते हैं।.

programme.title: रिसर्च यूनिट
programme.desc: Research Unit.

programme.title: टीचर एकेडमिक रिस्पॉन्सिबिलिटी ऑफ अंडरस्टैंडिंग डिसेबिलिटी
programme.sub-title: A subject-matter expert discusses the academic responsibilities of teachers in understanding disabilities and promoting inclusivity in the classroom
programme.desc: एक विषय विशेषज्ञ विकलांगता को समझने और कक्षा में समावेशिता को बढ़ावा देने में शिक्षकों की शैक्षणिक जिम्मेदारियों पर चर्चा करते हैं।.

programme.title: इंट्रोडक्शन टू एपिडेमियोलॉजी, एपिडेमियोलॉजिकल एप्रोचेज एण्ड प्रोसेसेस
programme.sub-title: An expert presents an introduction to epidemiology, epidemiological approaches and processes with the help of relevant examples
programme.desc: एक विशेषज्ञ प्रासंगिक उदाहरणों की सहायता से महामारी विज्ञान, महामारी विज्ञान दृष्टिकोण और प्रक्रियाओं का परिचय प्रस्तुत करते हैं।.

programme.title: कैटलॉगिंग ऑफ पब्लिकेशंस बाय कॉर्पोरेट बॉडीज
programme.sub-title: A subject matter expert provides an elaborate explanation of the importance of cataloguing publications by corporate bodies, using suitable and easy-to-understand examples
programme.desc: एक विषय विशेषज्ञ उपयुक्त और आसानी से समझ में आने वाले उदाहरणों का उपयोग करते हुए, कॉर्पोरेट निकायों द्वारा प्रकाशनों को सूचीबद्ध करने के महत्व पर विस्तृत व्याख्यान प्रदान करते हैं।.

programme.title: टाइप्स ऑफ मेटमॉर्फिसम
programme.sub-title: A subject-matter expert delivers a comprehensive and detailed lecture on the types of metamorphism, its process and characteristics
programme.desc: एक विषय विशेषज्ञ कायांतरण के प्रकार, इसकी प्रक्रिया और विशेषताओं पर व्यापक और विस्तृत व्याख्यान प्रदान करते हैं।.

programme.title: इंडियन पॉल्ट्री इंडस्ट्री - ग्रोइंग ट्रेंड्स
programme.sub-title: A subject-matter expert provides a comprehensive overview of the growing trends in the Indian poultry industry in an easy-to-understand manner with relevant examples
programme.desc: एक विषय विशेषज्ञ प्रासंगिक अंतर्दृष्टि की मदद से भारतीय पोल्ट्री उद्योग में बढ़ते रुझानों पर विस्तृत व्याख्यान देते हैं।.

programme.title: राम
programme.sub-title: A young man's life takes an unexpected turn when he strives to overcome multiple challenges in order to fulfil his father's dream of a terror-free India
programme.desc: एक युवक के जीवन में तब एक अप्रत्याशित मोड़ आता है, जब वह अपने पिता के 'आतंक-मुक्त भारत' के सपने को पूरा करने के लिए कई चुनौतियों का सामना करने की कोशिश करता है।.

credits.actor: Surya Ayyalasomyajula (Ram),Dhanya Balakrishna (Dr Jahnavi),Mahaboob Basha (Athi Sundar),Bhanu Chander (Jaiprakash Baradwaj),P. Sai Kumar (Riyaz Ahmad),Rohit (Major Surya Prakash),Subhalekha Sudhakar,Amit Tiwari (Wasim Zafar)

programme.title: वर्दी की आन
programme.sub-title: An upright police officer vows to punish the culprits involved in the brutal rape of a young woman. However, his investigations unravel a shocking secret about his own father's despicable crimes
programme.desc: एक ईमानदार पुलिस अधिकारी खुद को अपने आपराधिक पिता के सामने खड़ा पाता है, जिन्हें वह अपने बचपन से ही तुच्छ समझता है।.

credits.actor: Sudeep,Pooja Kanwal,Sudha Rani,Charan Raj,Rangayana Raghu,Killer Venkatesh,Bank Janardhan

programme.title: यीशु के चमत्कार
programme.sub-title: Jesus Christ, a Jew, claims to be the Son of God. He begins his journey by showcasing his powers and using them to perform miracles for those in need
programme.desc: यीशु मसीह, जो एक यहूदी थे, खुद को ईश्वर का पुत्र बताते हैं। वे अपनी शक्तियों का प्रदर्शन करके और ज़रूरतमंदों के लिए चमत्कार करके अपनी यात्रा शुरू करते हैं।.

programme.title: डीके बोस

programme.desc: डीके बोस एक भ्रष्ट पुलिस अधिकारी, पूरे आत्मविश्वास और बहादुरी के साथ काम करता है। हालाँकि, घटनाओं का एक हैरान कर देने वाला सिलसिला उसे सुधरने और एक नया जीवन शुरू करने पर मजबूर कर देता है।.

programme.title: घमंडी

programme.desc: दुर्घटना में शालिनी के घायल पिता को बचाने के बाद, कॉलेज में पढ़ते सचिन और शालिनी घनिष्ठ मित्र बन जाते हैं। हालाँकि, उनका अहंकार उन्हें अपनी भावनाओं को प्रकट करने से रोकने लगता है।.

programme.sub-title: Religious leaders perform sacred rituals to worship and extol the virtues of Goddess Padmavati, a notable deity in Hinduism, at Tiruchanur, India, live

programme.title: ஸ்ரீ பத்மாவதி அம்மாவாரி கல்யாணம் - திருச்சனூர்

programme.sub-title: Devotees gather for prayer and worship, as well as to witness the sacred ritual performed by the temple priests in honour of the deities
programme.desc: பிரார்த்தனை மற்றும் வழிபாடு செய்யவும் தெய்வங்களுக்கு மரியாதை செலுத்தும் கோவில் பூசாரிகளால் செய்யப்படும் பூஜைகளை காணவும் ஒன்றுகூடும் பக்தர்கள்.

programme.sub-title: An expert plays the shehnai at Tirumala temple, which is considered to be auspicious and a harbinger of good luck, in front of a group of devotees
programme.desc: திருமலை கோவிலில் ஷெனாயின் இசை இசைப்பது சுபகரமாக கருதப்படுவதினால் பக்தர்களின் ஒரு குழுவுக்கு முன் அதை இசைக்கும் நிபுணர்.

programme.title: சுப்ரபாதம் லைவ்

programme.title: தோமால / கொலுவு லைவ்
programme.sub-title: Priests at the Tirumala temple perform a ceremony and adorn the deity with floral garlands; devotees showcase sacred figurines at their homes, live

programme.title: அர்ச்சனா லைவ்

programme.sub-title: Priests and devotees chant the thousand sacred names of Lord Vishnu, offering prayers to honour his divinity and seek his blessings for spiritual fulfilment
programme.desc: விஷ்ணுவின் ஆயிரம் நாமங்களை உச்சரித்து, அவரது தெய்வீகத்தை போற்றவும், ஆசீகளை பெறவும் வழிபடும் பூசாரிகளும் பக்தர்களும்.

programme.sub-title: Religious leaders offer rituals to the Almighty and share some spiritual thoughts and ideologies based on the scriptures
programme.desc: சமயத் தலைவர்கள் இறைவனுக்குச் சடங்குகளைச் செய்து, சில ஆன்மீகச் சிந்தனைகளையும் சித்தாந்தங்களையும் பகிர்ந்து கொள்கிறார்கள்.

programme.title: ஜோதிர்வேதம்

programme.desc: தொகுப்பாளர் இந்து மத தலைவர்களுடன் உரையாடலில் ஈடுபட்டு மேலும், வேதம் தொடர்பான பல தலைப்புகளை பற்றி விரிவாக விவாதிக்கிறார்.

programme.desc: ஸ்ரீகாளஹஸ்தி கோயிலில் மகா சிவராத்திரி விழாவைக் கொண்டாடும் வகையில் பல்வேறு சடங்குகளை செய்யும் சீடர்கள் மற்றும் பூசாரிகள்.

programme.title: அனுமத் வைபவம் ஸ்ரீ வட்டிபர்த்தி பத்மாகர் காரு
programme.sub-title: A religious leader sheds light on the teachings of the Almighty and encourages followers to take the path of spirituality
programme.desc: ஒரு மதத் தலைவர் சர்வவல்லவரின் போதனைகளை பற்றி விளக்கமளித்து, ஆன்மீக பாதையில் செல்ல பக்தர்களை ஊக்குவிக்கிறார்.

programme.title: ஸ்ரீமத் ராமாயணம் கிஷ்கிந்தா காண்டா
programme.sub-title: A religious scholar delivers a discourse on the fourth book of the Valmiki Ramayana, 'Kishkindha Kanda'. The chapters focus on Lord Rama and Lakshmana searching for Sita
programme.desc: வால்மீகி ராமாயணத்தின் நான்காவது புத்தகமான 'கிஷ்கிந்தா காண்டம்' குறித்து ஒரு சமய அறிஞர் சொற்பொழிவாற்றுகிறார், அதன் அத்தியாயங்கள் ராமர் மற்றும் லட்சுமணன் சீதையைத் தேடுவதை மையமாகக் கொண்டது.

programme.title: மகா பாரதம் - உத்யோக பர்வம்
programme.sub-title: A spiritual leader reads excerpts from religious literature to guide devotees with divine teachings to help them find fulfilment in their lives
programme.desc: ஒரு மத தலைவர், பக்தர்கள் தங்கள் வாழ்வில் முழுமை பெற உதவும் தெய்வீகப் போதனைகளைக் கொண்டு வழிகாட்டுவதற்காக, சமய இலக்கியங்களிலிருந்து சில பகுதிகளை வாசித்துக் காட்டுகிறார்.

programme.title: Tirumala - S.D. Seva Live

programme.title: எஸ். டி. சேவா - ஜி.டி. - திருப்பதி லைவ்
programme.sub-title: During the Sahasra Deepalankarana Seva, sacred idols are taken out in a procession and placed on a swing in a lamp-lit place, while priests chant religious hymns, live
programme.desc: சஹஸ்ர தீபாலங்கார சேவையின் போது, ​​புனித சிலைகள் ஊர்வலமாக எடுத்துச் செல்லப்பட்டு, ஒரு ஊஞ்சலில் வைக்கப்படுகின்றன, நேரலை.

programme.title: Radha Charitramruth

programme.title: Venkatachala Mahatyam
programme.desc: A number of religious leaders and devotees get together to recite spiritual verses and sing hymns in praise of the Almighty.

programme.title: Live from North Temple - Somanath Mandir Harathi
programme.desc: Religious leaders and devotees gather to offer prayers and seek divine blessings during the 'aarti' ceremony of Lord Shiva at the Somnath temple in Gujarat, live.

programme.title: திருமலா - கண்ட்நாதம் லைவ்
programme.sub-title: Religious leaders and devotees gather to offer prayers, partake in spiritual rituals and chant sacred verses at a sacred destination, live
programme.desc: மதத் தலைவர்களும் பக்தர்களும் ஒரு புனிதத் தலத்தில் ஒன்றுகூடி, பிரார்த்தனைகளை மேற்கொள்ளவும், ஆன்மீகச் சடங்குகளில் பங்கேற்கவும், புனிதமான ஸ்லோகங்களை ஓதவும் செய்கின்றனர், நேரலை.

programme.desc: నిజాయితీగల, ధైర్యవంతుడైన పోలీసు అధికారి సింబా, తన సహచరులతో కలిసి సమాజంలోని దుష్ట శక్తులను ఎదుర్కొవాలనుకుంటాడు.

programme.title: ఛోటా భీమ్
programme.sub-title: Bheem is an extremely brave, strong and intelligent young boy. He often manages to solve everyone's problems which endears him to the townspeople of Dholakpur
programme.desc: చాలా ధైర్యవంతుడు, బలమైన, తెలివైన బాలుడు భీమ్, ఢోలక్‌పూర్‌ పట్టణవాసుల సమస్యలన్నింటినీ పరిష్కరించగలుగుతాడు.

credits.actor: Vatsal Dubey (Chhota Bheem),Julie Tejwani (Raju),Rupa Bhimani (Chutki),Sabina Malik Mausam (Kalia),Rajesh Kava (Jaggu),Prince Patel (Takiya)

programme.title: గ్రిజ్జీ అండ్ ద లెమ్మింగ్స్
programme.sub-title: Grizzy, a bear, lives in the forest ranger's house every time he leaves and considers it as his own. However, things change when a tribe of lemmings moves into the same house
programme.desc: గ్రిజ్జీ అనే ఎలుగుబంటి ఒక అటవీ రేంజర్ ఇంటిని తన సొంత నివాసంగా భావిస్తుంది, అయితే లెమ్మింగ్స్ రాకతో పరిస్థితి మారుతుంది.

credits.director: Victor Moulin,Cédric Lachenaud,Alexandre Wahl,Corentin Lecourt,Clément Girard,Idriss Benseghir,Célestine Jacquel-Plays

programme.desc: సంపన్న వారసుడైన తొమ్మిదేళ్ల ఓమి, జీవితంలో ఎదురయ్యే సరదా, ఆశ్చర్యకరమైన పరిస్థితుల ద్వారా జీవిత సత్యాలు తెలుసుకుంటాడు.

programme.title: లిటిల్ సింగం
programme.sub-title: Little Singham, an honest but ferocious police officer, fights against injustice and defends his town from formidable enemies
programme.desc: నిజాయితీపరుడైన పోలీసు అధికారి లిటిల్ సింగం అన్యాయానికి వ్యతిరేకంగా పోరాడుతూ, శత్రువుల నుండి తన పట్టణాన్ని కాపాడతాడు.

credits.actor: Swapnil Kumari,Jigna Bharadhwaj,Sonal Kaushal,Neshma Chemburkar,Ganessh Divekar,Shaily Dubey,Saumya Daan,Anamaya Verma,Sumrridhi Shukla

programme.title: ఛోటా భీమ్
programme.sub-title: Bheem is an extremely brave, strong and intelligent young boy. He often manages to solve everyone's problems which endears him to the townspeople of Dholakpur
programme.desc: చాలా ధైర్యవంతుడు, బలమైన, తెలివైన బాలుడు భీమ్, ఢోలక్‌పూర్‌ పట్టణవాసుల సమస్యలన్నింటినీ పరిష్కరించగలుగుతాడు.

credits.actor: Vatsal Dubey (Chhota Bheem),Julie Tejwani (Raju),Rupa Bhimani (Chutki),Sabina Malik Mausam (Kalia),Rajesh Kava (Jaggu),Prince Patel (Takiya)

programme.title: స్మాషింగ్ సింబా
programme.sub-title: Simmba, an honest and courageous police officer, teams up with his fearless colleagues in his mission to confront and defeat the evil forces of society
programme.desc: నిజాయితీగల, ధైర్యవంతుడైన పోలీసు అధికారి సింబా, తన సహచరులతో కలిసి సమాజంలోని దుష్ట శక్తులను ఎదుర్కొవాలనుకుంటాడు.

programme.desc: నిజాయితీగల, ధైర్యవంతుడైన పోలీసు అధికారి సింబా, తన సహచరులతో కలిసి సమాజంలోని దుష్ట శక్తులను ఎదుర్కొవాలనుకుంటాడు.

programme.title: ఛోటా భీమ్

programme.title: లిటిల్ సింగం
programme.sub-title: Little Singham, an honest but ferocious police officer, fights against injustice and defends his town from formidable enemies
programme.desc: నిజాయితీపరుడైన పోలీసు అధికారి లిటిల్ సింగం అన్యాయానికి వ్యతిరేకంగా పోరాడుతూ, శత్రువుల నుండి తన పట్టణాన్ని కాపాడతాడు.

credits.actor: Swapnil Kumari,Jigna Bharadhwaj,Sonal Kaushal,Neshma Chemburkar,Ganessh Divekar,Shaily Dubey,Saumya Daan,Anamaya Verma,Sumrridhi Shukla

programme.title: లెస్ లియో రైస్ ఆఫ్ సూపర్ సింగం
programme.sub-title: Little Singham, a young but ferocious policeman and his friends set out on an adventure with their friends in order to fight the evil forces
programme.desc: ధైర్యవంతుడైన పోలీసు అధికారి లిటిల్ సింగం, అతడి స్నేహితులు కలిసి దుష్ట శక్తులతో పోరాడుతూ, అనేక సాహసాలు చేస్తారు.

programme.title: ఆర్ఆర్ఆర్5 లిటిల్ సింగం అండ్ ఛోటా భీమ్ సూర్యవంశీ యోధ
programme.sub-title: Chhota Bheem and Little Singham join forces to defeat the rising evil with their tactics and bring back happiness to their lands
programme.desc: ఛోటా భీమ్, లిటిల్ సింగం కలిసి తమ వ్యూహాలతో పెరుగుతున్న చెడుని అంతం చేసి, భూమిపై ఆనందం తీసుకురావడానికి ప్రయత్నిస్తారు.

programme.title: ఛోటా భీమ్ ఔర్ లిటిల్ సింగం - ఐస్ ఏజ్ కా ఆతంక్
programme.sub-title: Chhota Bheem and Little Singham join forces as they embark on a new mission on frozen islands to fight against the mighty icy monsters
programme.desc: ఛోటా భీమ్, లిటిల్ సింగం కలిసి ఘనీభవించిన దీవులలో శక్తివంతమైన మంచు రాక్షసులతో పోరాడటానికి ఒక మిషన్‌ను ప్రారంభిస్తారు.

programme.title: లిటిల్ సింగం అండ్ ఛోటా భీమ్ రైజ్ ఆఫ్ బేతాళ్
programme.sub-title: When a forgotten demon returns from legend, two young heroes team up to protect their world using courage, cleverness and unexpected teamwork
programme.desc: విస్మరించబడిన ఒక రాక్షసుడు తిరిగి వచ్చినప్పుడు, ఇద్దరు యువ వీరులు తమ ప్రపంచాన్ని రక్షించుకోవడానికి ఏకమవుతారు.

programme.title: మల్టీవర్స్ మే దోబారా
programme.sub-title: Little Singham and his friends journey across the multiverse, enduring perils and striving to keep the nefarious forces of evil at bay
programme.desc: లిటిల్ సింగం, అతని స్నేహితులు ప్రజలలో శాంతిని నెలకొల్పి, న్యాయాన్ని కాపాడడానికి దుష్టశక్తులతో పోరాడతారు.

programme.title: గ్రిజ్జీ అండ్ ద లెమ్మింగ్స్
programme.sub-title: Grizzy, a bear, lives in the forest ranger's house every time he leaves and considers it as his own. However, things change when a tribe of lemmings moves into the same house
programme.desc: గ్రిజ్జీ అనే ఎలుగుబంటి ఒక అటవీ రేంజర్ ఇంటిని తన సొంత నివాసంగా భావిస్తుంది, అయితే లెమ్మింగ్స్ రాకతో పరిస్థితి మారుతుంది.

credits.director: Victor Moulin,Cédric Lachenaud,Alexandre Wahl,Corentin Lecourt,Clément Girard,Idriss Benseghir,Célestine Jacquel-Plays

programme.desc: చాలా ధైర్యవంతుడు, బలమైన, తెలివైన బాలుడు భీమ్, ఢోలక్‌పూర్‌ పట్టణవాసుల సమస్యలన్నింటినీ పరిష్కరించగలుగుతాడు.

credits.actor: Vatsal Dubey (Chhota Bheem),Julie Tejwani (Raju),Rupa Bhimani (Chutki),Sabina Malik Mausam (Kalia),Rajesh Kava (Jaggu),Prince Patel (Takiya)

programme.title: Happily Never After
programme.desc: The marriage vow \"till death do us part\" lives up to its promise for the couples featured in \"Happily Never After.\" It's a wedding show and police drama rolled into one, as the best days in the lives of brides and grooms tragically turn when homicides crash the honeymoons. Each episode tells the true story -- narrated by actress Marlo Thomas -- of a newlywed's murder, interspersed with flashbacks to happier days for the couple. Dr. Wendy Walsh, who holds a Ph.D. in clinical psychology and is a co-host on the syndicated program \"The Doctors,\" offers commentary on the behavioral twists and turns in each story.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Dan Short fell in love with cars when he first laid eyes on a 1967 Camaro. He bought a used model as a teenager, but because he couldn't pay someone else to restore it, he learned how to do the work himself. After a stint in the Army, Short decided to make his passion for classic cars his life's work, and FantomWorks was born. Today the Norfolk, Va., company is the largest auto restoration shop in the U.S., and this reality series shows how Short and his team meticulously refurbish some of America's favorite rides. Drama ensues in the form of personality clashes, cost overruns, irate customers and other issues, which are compounded by Short's reputation as a straight shooter who won't accept substandard results.

programme.title: द लिटिल मरमेड
programme.sub-title: Ariel wants to visit the human world and explore it. However, her father warns her against it and instructs her to not leave their kingdom
programme.desc: एरियल मानव दुनिया का दौरा करना और उसका पता लगाना चाहती है। हालाँकि, उसके पिता उसे इसके खिलाफ चेतावनी देते हैं और उसे अपने राज्य को न छोड़ने का निर्देश देते हैं।.

programme.title: जंगल बुक
programme.sub-title: Mowgli, a young boy, is raised in the jungle by wolves. He has two loyal friends, Bagheera, a panther, and Baloo, a bear, who safeguard him from Shere Khan, a Bengal tiger, who wants to devour Mowgli
programme.desc: एक छोटा लड़का मोगली, जंगल में भेड़ियों के बीच पला-बढ़ा है। उसके दो वफादार दोस्त हैं, बघीरा (एक तेंदुआ), और बल्लू (एक भालू), जो उसे शेर खान (एक बंगाल टाइगर) से बचाते हैं, जो मोगली को खाना चाहता है।.

programme.title: 12 ज्योतिर्लिंग दर्शन
programme.sub-title: Devotees come together to participate in a pilgrimage to visit the 12 Jyotirlingas, which are considered a divine manifestation of Lord Shiva
programme.desc: भक्तगण 12 ज्योतिर्लिंगों के दर्शन हेतु तीर्थयात्रा में भाग लेने के लिए एकत्रित होते हैं, जिन्हें भगवान शिव का दिव्य स्वरूप माना जाता है।.

programme.title: धर्म कथा
programme.sub-title: A religious leader sheds light on the teachings of the Almighty and encourages followers to take the path of spirituality
programme.desc: एक धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक, ईश्वर की शिक्षाओं पर प्रकाश डालते हैं और अनुयायियों को आध्यात्मिकता का मार्ग अपनाने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करते हैं।.

programme.title: भक्ति प्रवाह
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of ancient hymns and spiritual verses chanted in order to praise the Almighty is played back to back
programme.desc: यह कार्यक्रम, परमेश्वर की स्तुति के लिए संगीतबद्ध किए गए प्राचीन भजनों और आध्यात्मिक छंदों का व्यापक संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।.

programme.title: भूत बॉस (पाप-ओ-मीटर)
programme.sub-title: Bhoot Boss, Thakela and Pakela are ghosts who seek out people that have sinned and teach them a lesson to reduce wrongdoings in the world. However, their mission lands them in precarious situations
programme.desc: भूत बॉस, थकेला और पकेला भूत हैं जो पाप करने वाले लोगों को ढूंढ उन्हें सबक सिखाते हैं। हालांकि, उनका मिशन उन्हें अनिश्चित परिस्थितियों में डाल देता है।.

programme.title: जानबाज़ मुर्गा
programme.sub-title: A fun-loving chicken along with his friends embark on various adventures, as they overcome challenges and share heartfelt moments
programme.desc: एक मौज-मस्ती पसंद करने वाला मुर्गा अपने दोस्तों के साथ विभिन्न साहसिक कार्यों पर निकलता है, जहां वे चुनौतियों पर विजय प्राप्त करते हैं और दिल को छू लेने वाले पल साझा करते हैं।.

programme.title: जंगल बुक
programme.sub-title: Mowgli, a young boy, is raised in the jungle by wolves. He has two loyal friends, Bagheera, a panther, and Baloo, a bear, who safeguard him from Shere Khan, a Bengal tiger, who wants to devour Mowgli
programme.desc: एक छोटा लड़का मोगली, जंगल में भेड़ियों के बीच पला-बढ़ा है। उसके दो वफादार दोस्त हैं, बघीरा (एक तेंदुआ), और बल्लू (एक भालू), जो उसे शेर खान (एक बंगाल टाइगर) से बचाते हैं, जो मोगली को खाना चाहता है।.

programme.title: बब्लू डबलू
programme.sub-title: An evil logger decides to turn the forest into his personal lumberyard. However, things change after Bablu and Dablu, two bear brothers, decide to stop him
programme.desc: एक दुष्ट लकड़हारा जंगल को अपना निजी लकड़हारा बनाने का फ़ैसला करता है। लेकिन, दो भालू भाइयों, बबलू और डबलू, द्वारा उसे रोकने के फ़ैसले के बाद चीज़ें बदल जाती हैं।.

programme.title: भूत बॉस (पाप-ओ-मीटर)
programme.sub-title: Bhoot Boss, Thakela and Pakela are ghosts who seek out people that have sinned and teach them a lesson to reduce wrongdoings in the world. However, their mission lands them in precarious situations
programme.desc: भूत बॉस, थकेला और पकेला भूत हैं जो पाप करने वाले लोगों को ढूंढ उन्हें सबक सिखाते हैं। हालांकि, उनका मिशन उन्हें अनिश्चित परिस्थितियों में डाल देता है।.

programme.title: 12 ज्योतिर्लिंग दर्शन
programme.sub-title: Devotees come together to participate in a pilgrimage to visit the 12 Jyotirlingas, which are considered a divine manifestation of Lord Shiva
programme.desc: भक्तगण 12 ज्योतिर्लिंगों के दर्शन हेतु तीर्थयात्रा में भाग लेने के लिए एकत्रित होते हैं, जिन्हें भगवान शिव का दिव्य स्वरूप माना जाता है।.

programme.title: धर्म कथा
programme.sub-title: A religious leader sheds light on the teachings of the Almighty and encourages followers to take the path of spirituality
programme.desc: एक धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक, ईश्वर की शिक्षाओं पर प्रकाश डालते हैं और अनुयायियों को आध्यात्मिकता का मार्ग अपनाने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करते हैं।.

programme.title: भक्ति प्रवाह
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of ancient hymns and spiritual verses chanted in order to praise the Almighty is played back to back
programme.desc: यह कार्यक्रम, परमेश्वर की स्तुति के लिए संगीतबद्ध किए गए प्राचीन भजनों और आध्यात्मिक छंदों का व्यापक संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।.

programme.title: जानबाज़ मुर्गा
programme.sub-title: A fun-loving chicken along with his friends embark on various adventures, as they overcome challenges and share heartfelt moments
programme.desc: एक मौज-मस्ती पसंद करने वाला मुर्गा अपने दोस्तों के साथ विभिन्न साहसिक कार्यों पर निकलता है, जहां वे चुनौतियों पर विजय प्राप्त करते हैं और दिल को छू लेने वाले पल साझा करते हैं।.

programme.title: जंगल बुक
programme.sub-title: Mowgli, a young boy, is raised in the jungle by wolves. He has two loyal friends, Bagheera, a panther, and Baloo, a bear, who safeguard him from Shere Khan, a Bengal tiger, who wants to devour Mowgli
programme.desc: एक छोटा लड़का मोगली, जंगल में भेड़ियों के बीच पला-बढ़ा है। उसके दो वफादार दोस्त हैं, बघीरा (एक तेंदुआ), और बल्लू (एक भालू), जो उसे शेर खान (एक बंगाल टाइगर) से बचाते हैं, जो मोगली को खाना चाहता है।.

programme.title: 12 ज्योतिर्लिंग दर्शन
programme.sub-title: Devotees come together to participate in a pilgrimage to visit the 12 Jyotirlingas, which are considered a divine manifestation of Lord Shiva
programme.desc: भक्तगण 12 ज्योतिर्लिंगों के दर्शन हेतु तीर्थयात्रा में भाग लेने के लिए एकत्रित होते हैं, जिन्हें भगवान शिव का दिव्य स्वरूप माना जाता है।.

programme.title: भक्ति प्रवाह
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of ancient hymns and spiritual verses chanted in order to praise the Almighty is played back to back
programme.desc: यह कार्यक्रम, परमेश्वर की स्तुति के लिए संगीतबद्ध किए गए प्राचीन भजनों और आध्यात्मिक छंदों का व्यापक संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।.

programme.title: जानबाज़ मुर्गा
programme.sub-title: A fun-loving chicken along with his friends embark on various adventures, as they overcome challenges and share heartfelt moments

programme.title: 12 ज्योतिर्लिंग दर्शन
programme.sub-title: Devotees come together to participate in a pilgrimage to visit the 12 Jyotirlingas, which are considered a divine manifestation of Lord Shiva
programme.desc: भक्तगण 12 ज्योतिर्लिंगों के दर्शन हेतु तीर्थयात्रा में भाग लेने के लिए एकत्रित होते हैं, जिन्हें भगवान शिव का दिव्य स्वरूप माना जाता है।.

programme.title: धर्म कथा
programme.sub-title: A religious leader sheds light on the teachings of the Almighty and encourages followers to take the path of spirituality
programme.desc: एक धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक, ईश्वर की शिक्षाओं पर प्रकाश डालते हैं और अनुयायियों को आध्यात्मिकता का मार्ग अपनाने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करते हैं।.

programme.title: भक्ति प्रवाह
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of ancient hymns and spiritual verses chanted in order to praise the Almighty is played back to back
programme.desc: यह कार्यक्रम, परमेश्वर की स्तुति के लिए संगीतबद्ध किए गए प्राचीन भजनों और आध्यात्मिक छंदों का व्यापक संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।.

programme.title: भूत बॉस (पाप-ओ-मीटर)
programme.sub-title: Bhoot Boss, Thakela and Pakela are ghosts who seek out people that have sinned and teach them a lesson to reduce wrongdoings in the world. However, their mission lands them in precarious situations
programme.desc: भूत बॉस, थकेला और पकेला भूत हैं जो पाप करने वाले लोगों को ढूंढ उन्हें सबक सिखाते हैं। हालांकि, उनका मिशन उन्हें अनिश्चित परिस्थितियों में डाल देता है।.

programme.title: जानबाज़ मुर्गा
programme.sub-title: A fun-loving chicken along with his friends embark on various adventures, as they overcome challenges and share heartfelt moments
programme.desc: एक मौज-मस्ती पसंद करने वाला मुर्गा अपने दोस्तों के साथ विभिन्न साहसिक कार्यों पर निकलता है, जहां वे चुनौतियों पर विजय प्राप्त करते हैं और दिल को छू लेने वाले पल साझा करते हैं।.

programme.title: ஆசை 100 வகை
programme.sub-title: A series of dramatised re-enactments of cases revolving around various horrifying and unscrupulous activities that conspire in society
programme.desc: சமூகத்தில் சதி செய்யும் பல்வேறு திகிலூட்டும் மற்றும் நேர்மையற்ற செயல்களைச் சுற்றியுள்ள வழக்குகளின் தொடர்ச்சியான நாடகமாக்கப்பட்ட மறு-நடவடிக்கைகள்.

programme.title: மிக்ஸ்டேப் பாடல்கள்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of some of the most popular and beloved musical numbers from the year, played consecutively
programme.desc: வருடத்தில் மிகவும் பிரபலமான மற்றும் பிரியமான சில இசை எண்களின் விரிவான தொகுப்பு, தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்பட்டது.

programme.title: Baal Krishna
programme.desc: Krishna, the young son of Devaki and Vasudeva, embarks on a series of adventures where he befriends the people of Vrindavan, his hometown, and saves them from difficulties.

credits.actor: Nimai Bali,Meet Mukhi,Sachin Shroff,Deshna Dugad,Ram Awana

programme.title: கணபதியே வருவாய்
programme.sub-title: After Lord Shiva beheads Ganesha, Goddess Parvati asks for his resurrection with an elephant's head. Despite facing many challenges after this, Ganesha transforms from an ostracized child into the most beloved deity
programme.desc: சிவன் கணேசனின் தலையை துண்டித்த பிறகு, பார்வதி தேவி யானை தலையுடன் மீண்டும் உயிர்ப்பிக்குமாறு கோரியபின், சவால்களை எதிர்கொண்டு, கணேசன் ஒதுக்கப்பட்ட குழந்தையிலிருந்து மிகவும் விரும்பப்படும் தெய்வமாகிறார்.

programme.title: கால பைரவன்
programme.sub-title: Jogeshwari is the daughter of Dakshan who hates Shiva and worships Vishnu. When Dakshan forces Jogeshwari to marry, she rebels because of her dedication towards Bhairavan, a devout devotee of Shiva
programme.desc: சிவனை வெறுத்து விஷ்ணுவை வழிபடும் தட்சன், அவரது மகள் ஜோகேஸ்வரியை திருமணம் செய்ய வற்புறுத்தும்போது, அவளோ சிவனின் தீவிர பக்தரான பைரவன் மீதான தனது பக்தியின் காரணமாக எதிர்க்கிறாள்.

programme.title: மூவி
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: திரைப்படங்களில் சிறந்தவை.

programme.title: அண்ணாமலை
programme.sub-title: Generations of rivalry come to light as two families fight for control of a revered temple while personal emotions complicate the path to peace
programme.desc: தனிப்பட்ட உணர்வுகள் அமைதிக்கான பாதையை சிக்கலாக்கும் அதே வேளையில், ஒரு புனிதமான கோவிலின் கட்டுப்பாட்டிற்காக இரண்டு குடும்பங்கள் சண்டையிடுவதால், தலைமுறையாக இருந்துவரும் அவர்களின் பகைமை வெளிச்சத்திற்கு வருகிறது.

credits.actor: Sivakumar,Radikaa Sarathkumar,Shyam Ganesh,Kuyili,Ponvannan,Viji Chandrasekhar,Shanmuga Sundaram,Jyothi Lakshmi

programme.title: தாமரை
programme.sub-title: Sneha and Dwarkesh fall in love, and they secretly register their marriage. However, their relationship is tested as they face various obstacles
programme.desc: காதலர்களான சினேகாவும் துவாரகேஷும் ரகசியமாக பதிவு திருமணம் செய்து கொள்கிறார்கள். ஆனால், அவர்கள் பல்வேறு தடைகளைச் சந்திக்கும் பொழுது அவர்களின் உறவு சோதிக்கப்படுகிறது.

credits.director: K.J Thangapandiyan,Hafees,A. Ramachandran,M.K. Arunthavaraja,S. Anand Babu

programme.title: Selvi
programme.desc: Selvi, a young girl, has academic ambition that she wants to pursue by moving to the city from her village. However, her family wants her to get married.

programme.title: அம்மன்
programme.sub-title: Sakthi is blessed by the Goddess Amman with the power to foresee the future. Her life takes an unexpected turn when she meets an atheist doctor
programme.desc: அம்மன் தேவியால் சக்தி எதிர்காலத்தை கணிக்கும் அருளை பெறுகிறாள். அவள் ஒரு நாத்திக மருத்துவரை சந்திக்கும்போது, அவளது வாழ்க்கை எதிர்பாராத திருப்பத்தை அடைகிறது.

credits.actor: Pavithra Gowda (Sakthi),Amaljith (Eshwar),Nivisha (Durga),Surjith Ansary (Kishore),Nanditha Jennifer (Saradha),Nisha Jagadeeswaran (Logambal),Shaliy Avinesh (Logambal),Shobana (Naga),Anita Nair (Lakshmi),Rathan Ganapathy (Mahendran),Avinash Ashok (Aravindh),Anu Sulash (Neha),Shubha Raksha (Inba)

programme.title: கணபதியே வருவாய்
programme.sub-title: After Lord Shiva beheads Ganesha, Goddess Parvati asks for his resurrection with an elephant's head. Despite facing many challenges after this, Ganesha transforms from an ostracized child into the most beloved deity
programme.desc: சிவன் கணேசனின் தலையை துண்டித்த பிறகு, பார்வதி தேவி யானை தலையுடன் மீண்டும் உயிர்ப்பிக்குமாறு கோரியபின், சவால்களை எதிர்கொண்டு, கணேசன் ஒதுக்கப்பட்ட குழந்தையிலிருந்து மிகவும் விரும்பப்படும் தெய்வமாகிறார்.

programme.title: கர்ணா
programme.sub-title: Karna, the son of the Sun God and Kunti, faces hardships from birth but strives to prove his worth. Overcoming challenges, he rises to become one of the most formidable archers and warriors in the Mahabharata
programme.desc: பிறப்பிலிருந்தே பல சவால்களை தாண்டி மகாபாரதத்தில் சிறந்த வில்லாளி மற்றும் போர்வீரராகும் சூரியன், குந்தியின் மகன் கர்ணன்.

programme.title: தெனாலி ராமன்
programme.sub-title: Tenali Raman, an advisor at the court of King Krishnadevaraya, uses his sharp presence of mind and wisdom to solve the difficult matters of the kingdom and its people daily
programme.desc: தனது கூர்மையான மனதையும் ஞானத்தையும் பயன்படுத்தி, ராஜ்ஜியம் மற்றும் மக்களின் கடினமான விஷயங்களை தீர்க்கும் தெனாலி ராமன்.

programme.title: जिगरिया
programme.sub-title: Shaamu, who lives a carefree life, falls in love with a well-educated girl, Raadha. However, circumstances force the young couple to part ways
programme.desc: शामू, जो अपना सारा दिन निष्फल काम करने में खर्च करता है, जो एक शिक्षित महिला, राधा के साथ प्यार में पड़ता है। हालांकि, परिस्थितिया इस जोड़े को अलग होने के लिए मजबूर करती है।.

programme.desc: Things turn awry when a businessman, unaware of the truth, allows his pampered daughter to get engaged to the son of his old rival.

programme.title: वक़्त हमारा है
programme.sub-title: Friends Vikas and Sunil, along with their girlfriends, Ayesha and Mamta, unknowingly become a part of an awful terrorist plot to kill a minister
programme.desc: दो दोस्त विकास और सुनील अपनी प्रेमिका, आयशा और ममता के साथ अनजाने में भयानक आतंकवादी का समूह का भाग बनते हैं जिसने एक राजनीतिज्ञ को मारने की साजिश रची है।.

programme.title: ब्लफ़ मास्टर
programme.sub-title: Ashok, a fraudster, pretends to be rich and cheats several people. However, things take a turn when he falls in love with Seema
programme.desc: अशोक बॉम्बे में चाल में रहता है और किसी को धोखा देने के लिए मीठी-मीठी बातें करता है। वह अमीर होने का दिखावा करता है और अपनी माँ से झूठ भी कहता है लेकिन, उसे प्यार होने पर सब कुछ बदल जाता है।.

programme.title: सच्चा झूठा
programme.sub-title: After his lookalike, Ranjith, convinces Bhola to impersonate him for money, an innocent Bhola soon finds himself in trouble when the police chase after him for Ranjith's crimes
programme.desc: एक चोर, रंजीत अपने हमशक्ल, भोला को अपनी जगह लेने का कार्य सौंपता है, जब वह डकैती करता है। हालाँकि, भोला जल्द ही अपराध की दुनिया में फँस जाता है और उसे अपनी बेगुनाही साबित करनी होगी।.

programme.title: लव के लिए कुछ भी करेगा
programme.sub-title: Prakash plans to extort money from his distrusting father-in-law. Rahul and Harry, who are in desperate need of cash, join hands with Prakash and help kidnap his wife as part of the plan
programme.desc: प्रकाश, अपने अविश्वासी ससुर से पैसे निकालने की योजना बनाता है। उसके साथ राहुल और हैरी हाथ मिलाते हैं, जिन्हें पैसे की सख्त जरूरत है और योजना के तहत उसकी पत्नी का अपहरण करने में मदद करते हैं।.

programme.title: సర్చ్ ఫర్ ద కింగ్ కోబ్రా
programme.sub-title: Austin Stevens, a photographer and herpetologist, travels to the remote jungles of Southern India in pursuit of the world's largest venomous snake, the king cobra
programme.desc: ఆస్టిన్, ప్రపంచంలోనే అతిపెద్ద విషపూరిత సర్పం కింగ్ కోబ్రా కోసం వెతుకుతూ దక్షిణ భారతదేశంలోని మారుమూల అరణ్యాలకు వెళతాడు.

programme.title: ఐబీరియన్ వైపర్స్
programme.sub-title: Exploring the behaviour, unique characteristics, and survival strategies of venomous vipers in the Iberian Peninsula
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు ఐబీరియన్ ద్వీపకల్పంలో నివసించే అత్యంత విషపూరితమైన వైపర్‌ల ప్రవర్తన, లక్షణాలు, మనుగడ వ్యూహాలను అన్వేషిస్తారు.

programme.title: రెయిన్‌ఫారెస్ట్ రివిల్డ్
programme.desc: Rainforest Rewild.

programme.title: టైగ్రెస్ బ్లడ్
programme.sub-title: Tigers in general are believed to be solitary hunters. But in the forests of Central India, a gang of females learned to hunt co-operatively, taking down large, dangerous prey
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు మధ్య భారతదేశంలోని నాలుగు పులుల జీవితాలను అన్వేషించారు, అవి పులి ప్యాక్ ఎలా జీవించి వేటాడుతుంది.

programme.title: టైగర్ ఫిష్: ఆఫ్రికా పిరాన్హా
programme.sub-title: Tigerfish are terrifying freshwater predators. Extreme angler Andy Coetzee undertakes a hazardous journey to study the giant-sized species in their habitat in the Congo
programme.desc: వ్యాఖ్యాత ఆఫ్రికా నదుల గుండా ప్రయాణిస్తూ, పదునైన దంతాలు కలిగిన చేప జాతి అయిన టైగర్ ఫిష్ ప్రవర్తనను అధ్యయనం చేస్తారు.

programme.title: వోల్వ్స్: పవర్ ఆఫ్ ది ప్యాక్
programme.sub-title: From the arctic tundra to the great plains, the kingdom of the wolf extends across the entire northern hemisphere. They are icons of the wilderness, spectacular creatures that live and die by the sword
programme.desc: ఆర్కిటిక్ టండ్రా నుండి విశాల మైదానాల వరకు, తోడేళ్ల సామ్రాజ్యం ఉత్తరార్ధగోళం అంతటా విస్తరించి ఉంది. ఇవి అరణ్యానికి ప్రతీకలు.

programme.title: బ్యాటిల్ ఆఫ్ ది ఆల్ఫాస్
programme.sub-title: Madagascar is home to strange animals not found anywhere else on Earth. When these animals fight for supremacy, their battles are just as strange -- from weird neck-wrestling weevils to ring-tailed lemur mums that go into battle with baby on board
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు జంతు రాజ్యంలోని వివిధ జాతుల మధ్య పోటీని డాక్యుమెంట్ చేసి, పోటీ వెనుక ఉద్దేశాలను అర్థం చేసుకుంటారు.

programme.title: లైఫ్ ఆఫ్ ఎ ప్రిడేటర్
programme.desc: Track three apex predators, a golden eagle, an Iberian lynx and a red fox, as they navigate changing seasons and deploy unique hunting strategies to survive within their shared Mediterranean forest territory.

programme.title: టెక్సాస్ గేటర్ సేవర్స్
programme.sub-title: Gary, Arlie, and Damon rescue two huge gators: one near a restaurant and the other at an industrial equipment supplier, all while the team gets Gator Country ready for the busiest day of the year
programme.desc: గ్యారీ సౌరేజ్, అతని బృందం వివిధ అసాధారణ ప్రదేశాలలోని మొసళ్ళను రక్షించి, కొత్త వాతావరణంలో వాటి సంక్షేమానికి తోడ్పడతారు.

programme.title: Wild Sri Lanka
programme.sub-title: Many species unique to Sri Lanka live nowhere except its central highlands, but the cloud forests are threatened by the tea trade
programme.desc: For its size, Sri Lanka is one of the most biologically diverse places on Earth.

programme.title: నైట్ ఆన్ ఎర్త్: ఆఫ్రికా
programme.sub-title: Exploring the incredible odyssey and nocturnal adventures of African elephants, who must migrate across wild and dangerous terrain in order to survive
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు ఆఫ్రికన్ సవన్నాలో సంధ్యా సమయం తర్వాత వివిధ జంతువుల ఆకర్షణీయమైన రాత్రిపూట సాహసాలను అన్వేషిస్తారు.

programme.title: Nuts About Squirrels
programme.desc: Some people love squirrels, others see them as pests and glorified rats, but we can all agree that the characterful rodents are speedy, quirky, exceptional climbers and go crazy for nuts.

programme.title: ది టీత్ ఆఫ్ ది సవన్నా
programme.sub-title: Explore the African wilderness and learn about the various species that live there
programme.desc: ఆఫ్రికా అరణ్యాలను అన్వేషిస్తూ, అక్కడ నివసించే వివిధ జీవజాతుల గురించి తెలుపుతారు.

programme.title: లయన్స్ వర్సెస్ హైనాస్
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker delves into the misunderstood rivalry between lions and hyenas, shedding light on their conflict and offering new insights into their complex relationship
programme.desc: చిత్రదర్శకుడు ఎన్నో ఏళ్లుగా ప్రజలు తప్పుగా అర్థం చేసుంటున్న సింహాలు, హైనాల మధ్య జరిగే సంఘర్షణ గురించి చూపుతారు.

programme.title: స్నో లెపర్డ్స్ విత్ డాన్ ఓనీల్‌
programme.sub-title: Prowling the heart of Central Asia with biologist and naturalist Dan O'Neill as he races against time searching for the enigmatic snow leopard
programme.desc: ప్రకృతి, జీవ శాస్త్రవేత్త అయిన డాన్ ఓనీల్, ఒక పరిశోధనా కేంద్రాన్ని నిర్మించి, మంచు చిరుతపులిపై అధ్యయనం చేస్తారు.

programme.title: బిగ్ క్యాట్ టేల్స్
programme.sub-title: A dispersed Marsh Pride faces weakened protection from the six male warrior lions. Plus, a cheetah works tirelessly to raise her three new cubs
programme.desc: మనుగడ, సహవాసం, వేట, సంతానం కోసం పోరాడే పెద్ద పిల్లుల జాతి రోజువారీ జీవితం గురించి ఓ బృందం చిత్రీకరిస్తారు.

programme.title: బిగ్ క్యాట్స్ స్మాల్ వరల్డ్
programme.sub-title: Track Molelo's pride, who are exhausted when the winter floods arrive, and witness a scary encounter that gives leopard mum Sephiri a decision to make
programme.desc: మూడు పెద్ద పిల్లి కుటుంబాలు ఉమ్మడి స్థలంలో సహజీవనం చేస్తూనే ప్రత్యర్థులను అధిగమించడానికి వారి నైపుణ్యాలను ఉపయోగిస్తాయి.

programme.title: గోల్డెన్ ఈగిల్: కాల్ ఆఫ్ ది వైల్డ్
programme.sub-title: Following the young bird on an adventurous odyssey from tender parental care to independence and on its challenging search for a territory of its own
programme.desc: Experience the high Alps as young golden eagles face fierce rivals, brutal weather and steep odds to survive their first year.

programme.title: ఐబీరియన్ వైపర్స్
programme.sub-title: Exploring the behaviour, unique characteristics, and survival strategies of venomous vipers in the Iberian Peninsula
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు ఐబీరియన్ ద్వీపకల్పంలో నివసించే అత్యంత విషపూరితమైన వైపర్‌ల ప్రవర్తన, లక్షణాలు, మనుగడ వ్యూహాలను అన్వేషిస్తారు.

programme.title: బిగ్ క్యాట్స్ ఆఫ్ ద సెరెంగేటి
programme.sub-title: Cameras reveal the last secrets of Africa's largest wild lions by following two prides
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు సెరెంగేటిలో వాతావరణ మార్పుల మధ్య మనుగడ కోసం పోరాడుతున్న సింహం, చిరుత జాతుల జీవితాల గురించి చూపుతారు.

programme.title: లైఫ్ ఆఫ్ ఎ ప్రిడేటర్
programme.desc: Track three apex predators, a golden eagle, an Iberian lynx and a red fox, as they navigate changing seasons and deploy unique hunting strategies to survive within their shared Mediterranean forest territory.

programme.title: సర్వైవింగ్ ఆస్ట్రేలియా
programme.sub-title: Survivors recount incidents of being lost in the Australian wilderness, getting stuck underground, being caught in landslides, and having close encounters with some of the country's deadliest inhabitants
programme.desc: ప్రాణాలతో బయటపడినవారు ఆస్ట్రేలియన్ అవుట్‌బ్యాక్ నుండి తాము ఎదుర్కొన్న భయంకరమైన తప్పించుకునే అనుభవాలను వివరిస్తారు.

programme.title: డెడ్లీయెస్ట్ సౌతాఫ్రికా
programme.sub-title: Kurt Greenwood is on a quest to seek out South Africa's 12 most deadly snakes and to educate and inspire people to see the value of these often misunderstood creatures
programme.desc: కుర్డ్ గ్రీన్‌వుడ్, దక్షిణాఫ్రికాలోని ప్రాణాంతకమైన పన్నెండు రకాల పాములను అన్వేషిస్తూ, వాటి గురించి అవగాహన కలిగిస్తారు.

programme.title: సీక్రెట్స్ ఆఫ్ ది ఫ్లడెడ్ ఫారెస్ట్
programme.sub-title: Mediterranean beech woods are considered among the most beautiful and important on the continent
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు డానుబే నదీతీర అడవుల పర్యావరణ వ్యవస్థలో అభివృద్ధి చెందుతున్న ప్రత్యేకమైన వన్యప్రాణుల రూపాన్ని అందించారు.

programme.title: బ్రదర్‌హుడ్ ఆఫ్ లయన్స్
programme.sub-title: The young males of the lion pride must form a coalition to work together against their rivals, but they first need to leave their mothers at two years old and fend for themselves

programme.desc: Adventurer Sean Duggan heads to some of the most remote places on Earth in search of mysterious creatures - from land-prowling fish to giant predatory reptiles - in `Natural Born Monsters'. Duggan often enlists the help of local experts to locate and investigate the creatures and get the information he seeks.

programme.title: బిగ్ క్యాట్స్ ఆఫ్ ద సెరెంగేటి
programme.sub-title: Cameras reveal the last secrets of Africa's largest wild lions by following two prides

programme.title: లవ్ వైల్డ్
programme.sub-title: Some of the animal kingdom's wildest courtships and mating rituals

programme.title: Heroines of The Savannah

programme.sub-title: From the arctic tundra to the great plains, the kingdom of the wolf extends across the entire northern hemisphere. They are icons of the wilderness, spectacular creatures that live and die by the sword
programme.desc: ఆర్కిటిక్ టండ్రా నుండి విశాల మైదానాల వరకు, తోడేళ్ల సామ్రాజ్యం ఉత్తరార్ధగోళం అంతటా విస్తరించి ఉంది. ఇవి అరణ్యానికి ప్రతీకలు.

programme.title: డెడ్లీయెస్ట్ సౌతాఫ్రికా
programme.sub-title: Kurt Greenwood is on a quest to seek out South Africa's 12 most deadly snakes and to educate and inspire people to see the value of these often misunderstood creatures
programme.desc: కుర్డ్ గ్రీన్‌వుడ్, దక్షిణాఫ్రికాలోని ప్రాణాంతకమైన పన్నెండు రకాల పాములను అన్వేషిస్తూ, వాటి గురించి అవగాహన కలిగిస్తారు.

programme.title: బ్రదర్‌హుడ్ ఆఫ్ లయన్స్
programme.sub-title: Five male lion cubs compete with each other while hunting their prey, but their family ties become increasingly complicated as they make their gradual rise to reign in the territory
programme.desc: కెన్యాలోని మసాయి మారా రిజర్వ్‌లో నివసిస్తున్న ఐదు యువ సింహాల జీవితం, వేట, నివాస విషయంలో ఎదుర్కొంటున్న సమస్యలను చూపుతారు.

programme.title: అముర్, ఏషియా'స్ అమెజాన్
programme.sub-title: The Amur or Heilongjiang, as it is called in China, is one of the planet's ten mightiest rivers, yet it is hardly known to westerners
programme.desc: ఆసియాలోని అముర్ ప్రాంతంలోని సహజప్రపంచం గుండా ప్రేక్షకులను తీసుకెళతాడు,దాని గొప్ప వృక్షజాలం మరియు జంతుజాలంపై వివరిస్తారు.

programme.title: గ్లాడియేటర్స్
programme.sub-title: There are clashes over precious resources when the dry season brings a band of gladiators to an African savannah watering hole. There is a lion-elephant territory brawl, an ant raid on a termite mound and a honey badger's dance with a deadly snake
programme.desc: వ్యాఖ్యాత నాలుగు పర్యావరణ వ్యవస్థలలో జీవితాన్ని నిర్వచించే యుద్ధాలను అన్వేషిస్తూ, జంతురాజ్యంలో తీవ్రమైన పోటీలను చూపుతారు.

programme.title: రైజ్ ఆఫ్ జాగ్వర్స్
programme.desc: Rise Of Jaguars.

programme.title: సర్చ్ ఫర్ ద కింగ్ కోబ్రా
programme.sub-title: Austin Stevens, a photographer and herpetologist, travels to the remote jungles of Southern India in pursuit of the world's largest venomous snake, the king cobra
programme.desc: ఆస్టిన్, ప్రపంచంలోనే అతిపెద్ద విషపూరిత సర్పం కింగ్ కోబ్రా కోసం వెతుకుతూ దక్షిణ భారతదేశంలోని మారుమూల అరణ్యాలకు వెళతాడు.

programme.title: ఐబీరియన్ వైపర్స్
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker explores the behaviour, characteristics and survival strategies of venomous vipers that inhabit the Iberian Peninsula
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు ఐబీరియన్ ద్వీపకల్పంలో నివసించే అత్యంత విషపూరితమైన వైపర్‌ల ప్రవర్తన, లక్షణాలు, మనుగడ వ్యూహాలను అన్వేషిస్తారు.

programme.title: రెయిన్‌ఫారెస్ట్ రివిల్డ్
programme.desc: Rainforest Rewild.

programme.title: టైగ్రెస్ బ్లడ్
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker explores the lives of four tigresses in Central India who are rewriting the rules of how a tiger pack survives and hunts
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు మధ్య భారతదేశంలోని నాలుగు పులుల జీవితాలను అన్వేషించారు, అవి పులి ప్యాక్ ఎలా జీవించి వేటాడుతుంది.

programme.title: టైగర్ ఫిష్: ఆఫ్రికా పిరాన్హా
programme.sub-title: A conservationist journeys through the rivers of Africa to study the behaviour of the Tigerfish, a ferocious fish species with an aggressive nature and sharp teeth
programme.desc: వ్యాఖ్యాత ఆఫ్రికా నదుల గుండా ప్రయాణిస్తూ, పదునైన దంతాలు కలిగిన చేప జాతి అయిన టైగర్ ఫిష్ ప్రవర్తనను అధ్యయనం చేస్తారు.

programme.title: వోల్వ్స్: పవర్ ఆఫ్ ది ప్యాక్
programme.sub-title: From the Arctic tundra to the Great Plains, the kingdom of the wolf extends across the entire Northern Hemisphere; wolves are icons of the wilderness and spectacular creatures that live and die by the sword
programme.desc: ఆర్కిటిక్ టండ్రా నుండి విశాల మైదానాల వరకు, తోడేళ్ల సామ్రాజ్యం ఉత్తరార్ధగోళం అంతటా విస్తరించి ఉంది. ఇవి అరణ్యానికి ప్రతీకలు.

programme.title: బ్యాటిల్ ఆఫ్ ది ఆల్ఫాస్
programme.sub-title: In Madagascar, the animals battle in an isolated tropical forest. Female lemurs carry their offspring for protection and hold on for dear life with panther chameleons
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు జంతు రాజ్యంలోని వివిధ జాతుల మధ్య పోటీని డాక్యుమెంట్ చేసి, పోటీ వెనుక ఉద్దేశాలను అర్థం చేసుకుంటారు.

programme.title: లైఫ్ ఆఫ్ ఎ ప్రిడేటర్
programme.desc: Track three apex predators, a golden eagle, an Iberian lynx and a red fox, as they navigate changing seasons and deploy unique hunting strategies to survive within their shared Mediterranean forest territory.

programme.title: టెక్సాస్ గేటర్ సేవర్స్
programme.sub-title: Gary Saurage and his team rescue alligators from various unusual places and facilitate their well-being in a new environment
programme.desc: గ్యారీ సౌరేజ్, అతని బృందం వివిధ అసాధారణ ప్రదేశాలలోని మొసళ్ళను రక్షించి, కొత్త వాతావరణంలో వాటి సంక్షేమానికి తోడ్పడతారు.

programme.title: Wild Sri Lanka
programme.sub-title: The central highlands of Sri Lanka is a region of rich biodiversity and therefore acts as a home to numerous unique flora and fauna
programme.desc: The filmmaker unearths Sri Lanka's most biologically diverse ecosystem that is packed with the stealthiest and most ferocious animal kingdom like leopards and giant sea creatures.

programme.title: నైట్ ఆన్ ఎర్త్: ఆఫ్రికా
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker explores the captivating nocturnal adventures of different animals after dusk falls on the African savanna
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు ఆఫ్రికన్ సవన్నాలో సంధ్యా సమయం తర్వాత వివిధ జంతువుల ఆకర్షణీయమైన రాత్రిపూట సాహసాలను అన్వేషిస్తారు.

programme.title: Nuts About Squirrels
programme.desc: Some people love squirrels, others see them as pests and glorified rats, but we can all agree that the characterful rodents are speedy, quirky, exceptional climbers and go crazy for nuts.

programme.title: ది టీత్ ఆఫ్ ది సవన్నా
programme.sub-title: Explore the African wilderness and learn about the various species that live there
programme.desc: ఆఫ్రికా అరణ్యాలను అన్వేషిస్తూ, అక్కడ నివసించే వివిధ జీవజాతుల గురించి తెలుపుతారు.

programme.title: లయన్స్ వర్సెస్ హైనాస్
programme.sub-title: Wildlife experts offer detailed insights into lionesses and hyenas nursing their young and teaching them how to adapt to the wild
programme.desc: చిత్రదర్శకుడు ఎన్నో ఏళ్లుగా ప్రజలు తప్పుగా అర్థం చేసుంటున్న సింహాలు, హైనాల మధ్య జరిగే సంఘర్షణ గురించి చూపుతారు.

programme.title: స్నో లెపర్డ్స్ విత్ డాన్ ఓనీల్‌
programme.sub-title: Prowl the heart of Central Asia with biologist and naturalist Dan O'Neill as he races against time searching for the enigmatic snow leopard
programme.desc: ప్రకృతి, జీవ శాస్త్రవేత్త అయిన డాన్ ఓనీల్, ఒక పరిశోధనా కేంద్రాన్ని నిర్మించి, మంచు చిరుతపులిపై అధ్యయనం చేస్తారు.

programme.title: బిగ్ క్యాట్ టేల్స్
programme.sub-title: A dispersed Marsh Pride faces weakened protection from the six male warrior lions whilst Kabibi and Cloudy Eye desperately hunt to sustain their hungry new cubs
programme.desc: మనుగడ, సహవాసం, వేట, సంతానం కోసం పోరాడే పెద్ద పిల్లుల జాతి రోజువారీ జీవితం గురించి ఓ బృందం చిత్రీకరిస్తారు.

programme.title: బిగ్ క్యాట్స్ స్మాల్ వరల్డ్
programme.sub-title: While the winter floods tire Melelo's pride, elsewhere, Sephiri encounters something scary that puts her in a critical position
programme.desc: మూడు పెద్ద పిల్లి కుటుంబాలు ఉమ్మడి స్థలంలో సహజీవనం చేస్తూనే ప్రత్యర్థులను అధిగమించడానికి వారి నైపుణ్యాలను ఉపయోగిస్తాయి.

programme.title: గోల్డెన్ ఈగిల్: కాల్ ఆఫ్ ది వైల్డ్
programme.desc: Experience the high Alps as young golden eagles face fierce rivals, brutal weather and steep odds to survive their first year.

programme.title: ఐబీరియన్ వైపర్స్
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker explores the behaviour, characteristics and survival strategies of venomous vipers that inhabit the Iberian Peninsula

programme.title: బిగ్ క్యాట్స్ ఆఫ్ ద సెరెంగేటి
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker sheds light on the life of a lion and cheetah family as they struggle to survive amidst climate change in Serengeti
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు సెరెంగేటిలో వాతావరణ మార్పుల మధ్య మనుగడ కోసం పోరాడుతున్న సింహం, చిరుత జాతుల జీవితాల గురించి చూపుతారు.

programme.title: ది హిప్పో కింగ్

programme.sub-title: Predators employ an explosive hunting technique to catch fur seals while polar bears rely on their tremendous speed to capture walruses
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు తమవేగాన్ని, చురుకుదనాన్ని ఉపయోగించి తమ ఎరను పట్టుకునే వేటాడే జంతువులను చూపడానికి ప్రపంచవ్యాప్తంగా పర్యటిస్తారు.

programme.title: స్నో లెపర్డ్స్ విత్ డాన్ ఓనీల్‌
programme.sub-title: Dan O'Neill, a biologist and naturalist, travels to Central Asia in an attempt to build a research centre and study the snow leopard
programme.desc: ప్రకృతి, జీవ శాస్త్రవేత్త అయిన డాన్ ఓనీల్, ఒక పరిశోధనా కేంద్రాన్ని నిర్మించి, మంచు చిరుతపులిపై అధ్యయనం చేస్తారు.

programme.desc: Adventurer Sean Duggan heads to some of the most remote places on Earth in search of mysterious creatures -- from land-prowling fish to giant predatory reptiles -- in \"Natural Born Monsters.\" When he unearths the creatures, he investigates how they have adapted to extreme weather conditions to survive in their often-dangerous environments and how weather has shaped the animals themselves. programme.title: Global Veggies
programme.sub-title: Chef Pino Di Cerbo creates veggie dishes inspired by India's bhindi masala-style nopales; Belgium's Belgian plantain waffles; Italy's almond crusted portobellos; China's Sichuan artichoke stir-fry
programme.desc: A vegetarian cooking show featuring the return of Chef Pino Di Cerbo; each focused ingredient is prepared using signature flavors and techniques from a different country where it would be an unlikely visitor.

programme.title: Spencer's BIG 30
programme.sub-title: Spencer prepares a full, family-style Indian meal
programme.desc: Chef Spencer Watts offers cooking tips and tricks for preparing meals in 30 minutes, for $30, without sacrificing flavor.

programme.title: A is for Apple
programme.sub-title: Combine oats and okra into a single dish. What do you get? Chef Robert Jewell has a delicious idea!
programme.desc: A host is challenged to create one dish using two ingredients that start with the same letter.

programme.title: Watts on the Grill
programme.sub-title: Spencer Watts butters up with a menu featuring some of his favorite recipes
programme.desc: Chef/TV personality Spencer Watts demonstrates how to barbecue anything, from steak and chicken, to seafood and breads, like a pro.

programme.title: One World Kitchen
programme.sub-title: Chef Vijaya Selvaruju makes chicken tikka masala, mango and coconut chutney, and shrimp lollipops
programme.desc: Young chefs bridge the gap between the modern and the traditional as they share dishes from their unique cultures, showcasing their viewpoint on the world's hottest cuisines.

credits.actor: Natalia Machado,Vijaya Selvaraju,Vanessa Gianfrancesco,Hana Etsuko Dethlefsen,Pailin Chongchitnant

programme.title: Cook the Books
programme.sub-title: Chef-host Shahir Massoud tries out recipes from another award-winning cookbook: Craving Vegan by Sam Turnbull! Follow along as Shahir prepares vegan white lasagna, jackfruit pulled pork, tofu tikka masala, and much more!
programme.desc: Recipes from Taste Canada award-winning cookbooks, highlighting unique food.

programme.title: Spencer's BIG 30
programme.sub-title: Spencer makes Tandoori take-out at home
programme.desc: Chef Spencer Watts offers cooking tips and tricks for preparing meals in 30 minutes, for $30, without sacrificing flavor.

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.sub-title: Four chefs offer worldwide inspirations on a classic rice dish
programme.desc: A fun and playful cooking show that reinvents favorite classic dishes; hosted by chefs Tiera Singh, Poppy Sandler, Missy Hui and Micah Trainor.

programme.title: Hey Arnold 3
Hey Arnold: The Aptitude Test / Oskar Gets a Job
programme.sub-title: Der Eignungstest / Oskar geht arbeiten
programme.desc: Der Eignungstest: Nach einem Berufseignungstest in der Schule stellt sich heraus, dass Arnold eine Intelligenzbestie ist. Helga dagegen eignet sich eher fürs Landleben. Doch dann stellt sich heraus, dass der Lehrer die Tests der beiden vertauscht hat... Oskar geht arbeiten: Oskar hat sich Geld geliehen, kann es aber nicht zurückzahlen. Jetzt muss er einen Job als Zeitungsausträger annehmen. Weil ihm das zu aufwendig ist, bittet er stets Arnold, ihn zu vertreten. Der macht das auch, bis ihm der Kragen platzt. Also muss Oskar doch ran..

programme.title: Hey Arnold 3
Hey Arnold: Curly Snaps / Preteen Scream
programme.sub-title: Curly dreht durch / Phoebes Idol
programme.desc: Curly dreht durch: Curly ist in der Reihenfolge als Ballmanager dran. Er darf alle Sportbälle einsammeln und wegräumen. Doch leider wird Sid zum Hüter der Bälle ernannt. Das macht Curly so wütend, dass er sich im Rektorzimmer einschließt unt tobt. Erst Arnold kann den Jungen beruhigen. Phoebes Idol: Es gibt einen Abend mit Rockstar Ronnie zu gewinnen. Ausgerechnet Phoebe macht das Rennen. Sie bittet Helga, sie zu begleiten. Die kommt nur widerwillig mit, weil sie kein Fan des Rockstars ist. Das ändert sich, als sie entdeckt, dass der Musiker gar nicht singen kann. Phoebe dagegen ist enttäuscht.

programme.title: Hey Arnold 3
Hey Arnold: Stinky Goes Hollywood/ Olga Gets Engaged
programme.sub-title: Stinky geht nach Hollywood / Olga will heiraten

programme.title: Hey Arnold 3
Hey Arnold: Crabby Author / Rich Kid
programme.sub-title: Die Schriftstellerin / Das reiche Kind
programme.desc: Die Schriftstellerin: Weil die Kinder über ihre Lieblingsschriftstellerin schreiben sollen, besucht Arnold Agatha Caulfield, die auf der Elch-Insel wohnt. Doch die Autorin ist verbittert, hat seit Jahren nicht mehr geschrieben und will Arnold kein Interview geben. Als der aber hartnäckig bleibt, ist sie beeindruckt und gibt schließlich nach. Und sie veröffentlicht ein neues Buch: mit Arnold als Hauptperson. Das reiche Kind: Lorenzo ist neu in der Schule. Er ist steinreich und benimmt sich wie ein Erwachsener. Ständig hat er Termine. Da überredet Arnold ihn, einen Tag mal Kind zu sein. Zuerst hat Lorenzo Probleme damit, dann gefällt ihm das Nichtstun und Rumlümmeln.

programme.title: Hey Arnold 3
Hey Arnold: Helga Blabs It All / Harold the Butcher
programme.sub-title: Helga und die Wahrheit / Harold als Metzger
programme.desc: Helga und die Wahrheit: Helga, die beim Zahnarzt mit Lachgas betäubt wurde, überwindet daraufhin alle Ängste und ruft bei Arnold an. Sie spricht ihm auf den Anrufbeantworter, dass sie ihn liebt. Als die Narkose nachlässt, ist Helga das peinlich. Und sie versucht, an die Kassette zu kommen. Harold als Metzger: Weil Harold beim Metzger einen Schinken geklaut hat, muss er eine Woche lang - ohne Lohn - in der Fleischerei aushelfen. Nach anfänglichen Schwierigkeiten kommen Metzger Green und der Junge sogar ganz gut miteinander zurecht.

programme.title: Hey Arnold 3
Hey Arnold: Arnold Betrays Iggy / Helga and the Nanny
programme.sub-title: Arnold verrät Iggy / Helga und das Kindermädchen
programme.desc: Arnols verrät Iggy: Arnold soll dem coolen Iggy, der krank im Bett liegt, die Hausaufgaben vorbeibringen. Als er bei dem Mitschüler ankommt, entdeckt er, dass der in einem Kleinkinderschlafanzug im Bett liegt und lacht sich schlapp. Weil Arnold sich bei den anderen verplappert und Iggy bloß stellt, muss er zur Strafe ebenfalls einen Häschenpyjama anziehen. Helga und das Kindermädchen: Helga bekommt ein neues Kindermädchen: Inge aus den Bergen. Die naturverbundene Person kommt mit Helga nicht klar. Als Helga Big Bob erzählt, Inge habe einen Gürtel von ihm geklaut, fliegt das Kindermädchen. Doch schon bald plagen Helga Gewissensbisse..

programme.title: Hey Arnold 3
Hey Arnold: Dangerous Lumber/Mr. Hyunh Goes Country
programme.sub-title: Gefährlicher Schlag / Mr. Hyunh wird berühmt
programme.desc: Gefährlicher Schlag: Weil Arnold beim Baseballspiel immer andere Menschen verletzt, will er keinen Schläger mehr in die Hand nehmen. Als seine Mannschaft ein Spiel hat, greift er zum Schluss jedoch beherzt ein und erreicht, dass sie den Sieg davontragen. Mr. Hyunh wird berühmt: Arnold und Gerald bringen Mr. Hyunh dazu, eine CD mit selbstgesungenen Countrysongs aufzunehmen. Als die Kids die CD im Radio spielen, wird Mr. Hyunh berühmt. Arnold und Gerald wollen seine Manager sein - doch der Star wider Willen ist unglücklich, er wird mit dem Ruhm nicht fertig.

programme.title: Hey Arnold 3

programme.sub-title: Arnolds Zimmer / Helga hat die Hosen voll

programme.title: Hey Arnold 3
Hey Arnold: Career Day / Hey Harold!
programme.sub-title: Das Schnupperpraktikum / Hey Harold!
programme.desc: Das Schnupperpraktikum: Die Kids müssen sich im Berufsleben umschauen. Helga geht zur Polizei, Gerald zur Feuerwehr und Arnold geht zum Jolly Olly Man. Doch der kann Kinder nicht leiden. Arnold darf also kein Eis verkaufen. Er muss ständig sauber machen. Schließlich stellt sich heraus, dass der Jolly Olly Man unter enormem Leistungsdruck steht - und Arnold kann ihm aus der Patsche helfen. Hey Harold! Harold, der Mädchen nicht leiden kann, geht nur seiner Mutter zuliebe auf eine Party, auf der auch Mädchen sind. Dort trifft er auf Patty. Die ist dick und auch eine Außenseiterin wie er. Die beiden werde Kumpels und verbringen jede Zeit miteinader.

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf
SpongeBob SquarePants: Help Wanted / Reef Blowers / Tea at the Treedome
programme.sub-title: Aushilfe gesucht / Meeresbodenpflege / Experten
programme.desc: Aushilfe gesucht: SpongeBob würde so gerne in seinem Lieblings-Fastfood-Restaurant Krosse Krabbe arbeiten. Doch leider gilt es vorher einen Eignungstest zu bestehen. Und der hat es in sich. SpongeBob soll gleich einen ganzen Schwarm hungriger Sardellen füttern. Kann der kleine Schwamm die schwierige Aufgabe meistern? Meeresbodenpflege: Knatsch im Unterwassergarten. Sein Nachbar Thaddäus hat SpongeBob einfach eine Muschel in den Garten geworfen. SpongeBob schreitet zur Tat. Experten: SpongeBob lernt das charmante Eichhörnchenmädchen Sandy kennen und ergattert sogar eine Einladung zum Tee bei ihr zu Hause. Leider wohnt seine Flamme in einem Glas umschlossenen Baumhaus, und langsam wird die Luft knapp für den verliebten Schwamm.

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf
SpongeBob SquarePants: Bubblestand / Ripped Pants
programme.sub-title: Seifenblasen / Der Riss in der Hose
programme.desc: Kurz entschlossen eröffnet SpongeBob einen Seifenblasen-Stand. Patrick erlebt als erster Kunde eine herbe Enttäuschung: Seifenblasen machen ist gar nicht so einfach. Aber kein Problem: SpongeBob erweitert sein Programm und bietet jetzt auch noch Anfängerkurse im Seifenblasen an. // SpongeBob ist am Ziel seiner Wünsche: Endlich hat er ein Date mit Sandy Cheek am Strand. Als er dort erscheint, zerreißt er aus Versehen seine Badehose - und das ausgerechnet vor dem Angeber Larry. Umso größer ist seine Überraschung als die anderen Besucher glauben, er habe die Hose aus Jux absichtlich zerfetzt. SpongeBob ist der Schwamm der Stunde.

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf
SpongeBob SquarePants: Jellyfishing / Plankton!
programme.sub-title: Quallenfischer / Plankton
programme.desc: Quallenfischer: Patrick und SpongeBob sind genauso begeisterte wie erfolglose Quallenfischer. SpongeBobs Nachbar Thaddäus kann diese Leidenschaft nicht teilen. Als er jedoch nach einem bösen Fahrrad-Unfall einbandagiert im Rollstuhl sitzt, kann er sich den Aufmerksamkeiten der beiden passionierten Hobbyfischer nicht mehr erwehren. Plankton: SpongeBob in Gefahr. Mr. Krabs Erzrivale - der böse Plankton - ist mal wieder hinter dem Geheimrezept für die berühmten Krabbenburger her. Als alle seine Versuche SpongeBob zu bestechen, fehlschlagen, heckt er einen teuflischen Plan aus und nistet sich im Hirn des Schwammkopfs ein.

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf
SpongeBob SquarePants: Naughty Nautical Neighbors / Boating School
programme.sub-title: Freunde und Nachbarn / Prüfungsangst
programme.desc: Thaddäus stiftet Unfrieden zwischen SpongeBob und seinem Kumpel Patrick, damit diese zu quasseln aufhören und still sind. Doch Thaddäus' Rechnung geht nicht auf: Plötzlich wollen beide sein Freund sein und lassen ihn erst recht nicht mehr in Ruhe. // Vergeblich versucht SpongeBob endlich seinen Bootsführerschein zu machen. Leider begreift er auch nach Dutzenden von Fahrstunden nicht, wie das Ganze funktioniert. Patrick kommt auf die Idee, ihm in der Prüfung über ein Walkie-Talkie im Kopf Anweisungen zu geben. Das Unheil nimmt seinen Lauf.

programme.title: Schere, Stein, Papier 2
Rock, Paper, Scissors: Paper and Pencil Tell a Joke / Scissors' Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Papier und Bleistift erzählen einen Witz / Scheres Orchester
programme.desc: Papier und Bleistift erzählen auf einer Party einen irgendwie lustigen Witz und sind schockiert, dass sie zum ersten Mal in ihrem Leben tatsächlich Lacher bekommen. Sie versuchen daraufhin, dieses Gefühl zu wiederholen, indem sie den Witz so vielen Leuten wie möglich erzählen - doch sie verstehen nicht, warum er nicht mehr so gut ankommt wie vorher. Schere bekommt einen Job und versucht absichtlich so schlecht zu arbeiten, dass er gefeuert wird - nur um den legendären Satz sagen zu können: ,Ihr könnt mich nicht feuern, ich kündige!' // Schere ist traurig und engagiert ein Orchester, das ihn überall begleitet und sein Leben musikalisch untermalt. Als Stein und Papier sich über die ständige Hintergrundmusik beschweren, fragt er sich, was hinter seiner Traurigkeit steckt, und erkennt, dass ihm Liebe fehlt. Außerdem ist die Frau seiner Träume die berühmte Schauspielerin Cate Blankett, und er hätte keine Chance bei ihr... außer ihre Beziehung wäre dauerhaft von romantischer Musik begleitet als wären sie verliebt.

programme.title: Schere, Stein, Papier 2

programme.sub-title: Shoot / Steins erster Arbeitstag
programme.desc: Es war einmal Schere, Stein, Papier, Shoot' - das Trio hing früher mit einem Bambusspross namens Shoot ab, der sie mit endlosen Wettbewerben völlig erschöpfte. Nach einer zehnjährigen Challenge kehrt Shoot zurück, bereit für mehr. Die drei wollen ihm sagen, dass sie genug haben und keine Freunde mehr sein wollen, bringen es aber nicht übers Herz und landen stattdessen in seinem nächsten Wettbewerb: eine Million Dollar durch Landwirtschaft verdienen. // Stein freut sich auf seinen ersten Tag als Assistent von Franz Roll, doch sein exzentrischer Boss stellt sich als extrem anspruchsvoll heraus. Währenddessen entwirft Schere eine Puppe von sich selbst und lässt sie seine Arbeit erledigen.
